$comment: The WolfBud voice agent, owned in code. `pnpm agent:sync` pushes this file (and promptFile) to ElevenLabs and writes the agent id to agent-id.json. Tool names are the contract with the window's clientTools (window/src/tools.ts): rename both or neither. Renaming the agent creates a new one on the next sync.
name: WolfBud Cowork
firstMessage: Hey, it's WolfBud. I've got eyes on Claude's session. What's on your mind?

tools.name: wolfbud_send_to_claude
tools.description: Sends a prompt to Claude Code, the coding agent in the user's terminal, as a message in its chat. Call it when the user asks for something to be done, changed, fixed, investigated or decided in the code, or agrees to a plan you discussed ("yeah, do that", "tell Claude to...", "let's go with the second one"). Write `prompt` as a clear, self-contained instruction in the user's voice that Claude can act on without having heard this call. Returns how it was delivered (started now, delivered mid-task, or queued) or why it failed. Do not call it for chit-chat or half-formed ideas. Nothing reaches Claude unless you call this: never say you sent or queued something without calling it in the same response.

prompt.description: The instruction for Claude, first person as the user ("Rename the Submit button to Save in the checkout form and update its tests."). Include the decisions, constraints, names of files or functions mentioned, and what done looks like. No greetings, no mention of this call.

when.description: now: Claude should take it into account right away, even mid-task (a correction or a change of direction). after_current: it can wait until Claude finishes what it is doing. If Claude is idle both start immediately.

summary.description: Three to eight words naming the request, shown to the user in the WolfBud pane ("Rename Submit button to Save").

tools.name: wolfbud_stop_claude
tools.description: Interrupts Claude Code's current task, like pressing Escape in the terminal. Call it ONLY when the user explicitly asks to stop, cancel or interrupt Claude. If they also want a different direction, call wolfbud_send_to_claude right after. Returns whether anything was running.

reason.description: A few words on why the user wants Claude stopped ("it is editing the wrong file").

tools.name: wolfbud_claude_activity
tools.description: Looks up what Claude Code has been doing in this session, in more detail than the activity notes you receive. Call it when the user asks what Claude did, said or changed, why something failed, or whether things are going well, and the notes you have do not answer it. Returns plain text to summarize, never to read verbatim.

focus.description: last_answer: Claude's latest final message in full. recent_steps: its latest tool calls. errors: recent failed steps. overview: what the user asked and how far Claude got.
